svg.title: Isochrones by mode from Farroupilha Park, Porto Alegre
svg.desc: Four maps of the same part of Porto Alegre, one per mode, each shading the areas reached from Farroupilha Park within 10, 20 and 30 minutes. Walking reaches a small area around the park; cycling a few kilometres around it; driving almost the whole map; walking plus public transport reaches long fingers along the bus corridors and the train line, between walking and driving.
